verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS compliance platform like Drata, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The agent's read-only system-preference access and the community workarounds (VMs, dedicated laptops) are not product opt-out controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
